summary: Build 22 regression — Scripture reading-plan progress persistence for signed-in users. Ran /app/backend/tests/test_build22_scripture_progress_persistence.py (3 tests) against the deployed preview EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All 3 tests passed in 4.14s. Also independently corroborated via curl: guest returns day=1/progress=null, GET /api/daily-verse READS current_day and never advances, POST /api/daily-verse/complete on same local_date returns status='already_completed' with no double-advance, and changed build metadata (User-Agent, X-App-Version, X-Build-Number) plus cache-busting query params do NOT affect current_day.
seed_data_creation: Each test run self-seeds a fresh random user TEST_e2e_<8-hex>@prayersloft-qa.com with password TestPass1234!. Uses far-future local_date values (2031-*, 2032-*) so runs do not collide.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Persistence guarantees verified: (owner_key, plan_id) keying is stable across reload, build metadata churn, and re-login. GET is a pure READ; POST advances only when day==current_day and not already completed on that local calendar date. Guest path (X-Guest-Id only) always returns day=1 / progress=null. XML report at /app/test_reports/pytest/build22_scripture_progress_persistence.xml.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug. Regression add-on confirms existing server-authoritative behavior in /api/daily-verse and /api/daily-verse/complete is correct.
